use: Components of a system and how they connect, grouped by role (the default for any architecture question).
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  subgraph You[Вы]
    Voice[Голос]
    Panel[Панель]
  end
  subgraph Core[Butler]
    Ambient[Ambient service]
    Agent[Агент]
    Vault[(Хранилище)]
  end
  subgraph World[Внешний мир]
    Cloud[Модель]
    Mail[Почта]
  end
  Voice --> Ambient
  Panel <--> Ambient
  Ambient --> Agent
  Agent --> Vault
  Agent -. подписка .-> Cloud
  Agent --> Mail
    classDef core fill:#143d2a,stroke:#7fbf92,color:#d6ffe0
    classDef ext fill:#14263d,stroke:#6fa8dc,color:#d6e8ff
    classDef store fill:#2a1440,stroke:#b38cdc,color:#ecdcff
    classDef warn fill:#3d2a14,stroke:#e0a458,color:#ffe9c9
  class Voice,Panel,Ambient,Agent core
  class Cloud,Mail ext
  class Vault store
title: architecture

use: A stack of layers, top to bottom (UI, services, data; levels of trust).
mermaid:
flowchart TB
  subgraph L1[Интерфейс]
    A1[Панель]
    A2[Голос]
  end
  subgraph L2[Сервисы]
    B1[Ambient]
    B2[Диспетчер задач]
  end
  subgraph L3[Данные]
    C1[(Заметки)]
    C2[(Память)]
  end
  L1 --> L2
  L2 --> L3
    classDef core fill:#143d2a,stroke:#7fbf92,color:#d6ffe0
    classDef ext fill:#14263d,stroke:#6fa8dc,color:#d6e8ff
    classDef store fill:#2a1440,stroke:#b38cdc,color:#ecdcff
    classDef warn fill:#3d2a14,stroke:#e0a458,color:#ffe9c9
  class A1,A2,B1,B2 core
  class C1,C2 store
title: layers

use: Steps of a process with a decision and a failure path.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Start([Запрос]) --> Check{Разрешено?}
  Check -- да --> Work[Выполнить]
  Check -- нет --> Ask[Спросить владельца]
  Ask --> Check
  Work --> Done([Готово])
  Work -. ошибка .-> Fail[Сообщить и остановиться]
    classDef core fill:#143d2a,stroke:#7fbf92,color:#d6ffe0
    classDef ext fill:#14263d,stroke:#6fa8dc,color:#d6e8ff
    classDef store fill:#2a1440,stroke:#b38cdc,color:#ecdcff
    classDef warn fill:#3d2a14,stroke:#e0a458,color:#ffe9c9
  class Work,Start,Done core
  class Ask,Fail warn
title: pipeline

use: A request travelling between actors over time.
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant O as Владелец
  participant P as Панель
  participant A as Агент
  O->>P: Вопрос
  P->>A: Запрос
  A-->>P: Ответ
  P-->>O: Карточка и кнопки
  Note over P,A: Подтверждение только в терминале
title: sequence

use: Lifecycle of an object: states and the transitions between them.
mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Ожидание
  Ожидание --> Выполнение: запрос
  Выполнение --> Готово: успех
  Выполнение --> Ошибка: сбой
  Ошибка --> Ожидание: повтор
  Готово --> [*]
title: state

use: A data model: entities and how they relate.
title: er
